description: This file defines the MyTimesheetAPI class, which extends EmployeeTimesheetAPI to provide API endpoints for managing employee timesheets within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving validation rules for creating, updating, and fetching timesheets, with specific handling for employee numbers and date parameters.

classes.name: MyTimesheetAPI
classes.description: API class for managing employee timesheets, extending the base EmployeeTimesheetAPI, with customized validation rules for create, update, and retrieval operations.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the employee number of the authenticated user.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for fetching all timesheets, removing the 'employee number' parameter.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for creating a timesheet, removing predefined parameters and adding a date validation rule.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for updating a timesheet, removing the 'employee number' parameter.
